title: Self-Similar Solutions of the Two-Dimensional Incompressible Euler Equation from Large Initial Data
summary: Given $0<a<1$ and any $C^1$, divergence-free, $(-a)$-homogeneous vector field $u_0$ on the punctured plane, we construct a forward self-similar solution of the two-dimensional incompressible Euler equations on the plane with initial datum $u_0$. No smallness or sign condition is required. The solution is obtained as a vanishing-dissipation limit of hypodissipative self-similar profiles. The key estimate is a uniform vorticity profile bound in the critical Lorentz space $L^{\frac{2}{1+a},\infty}$.
